question: Where are a park found within a 190 kilometers limit in the southwest direction?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin( parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%_YOUR_REFERENCE_LOCATION_%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 190000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%_YOUR_REFERENCE_LOCATION_%' LIMIT 1), parks.geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 ;
